snippet.title: Ash and Flame // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3761130/Ash_and_Flame/

Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

Developed by 
Worlds In Portal aka @PortalInWorlds
